description: This file implements the PooledBuffer struct, a specialized buffer writer using pooled arrays designed for creating ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances. It manages memory segments, provides methods for writing, reading, slicing, enumerating, and converting the buffer data, as well as internal pooling mechanisms for efficient memory reuse.

classes.name: SequenceSegmentPool
classes.description: A singleton thread-safe pool for renting and returning SequenceSegment objects of various sizes, optimizing memory allocation for buffer segments.

classes.name: SequenceSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of a sequence, including memory management, resizing capabilities, and linkage to next segments, used internally by PooledBuffer.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.ToArray
methods.description: Converts the written data in the buffer to a byte array.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.Advance
methods.description: Advances the current write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer, returning all memory segments.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the buffer by resetting it.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> of at least sizeHint, growing the buffer if needed.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> of at least sizeHint for writing.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the buffer's contents into a provided span, buffer, or buffer writer.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.AsReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Creates a ReadOnlySequence<byte> over the written data.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.Slice
methods.description: Creates a BufferSlice referencing part of the buffer.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.MemoryEnumerator.MoveNext
methods.description: Advances to the next segment in buffer enumeration.

methods.name: PooledBuffer.SpanEnumerator.MoveNext
methods.description: Advances to the next span in buffer enumeration.
